tenderSchedule.description: As mentioned in the section III of tender document

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Total Contract Value of Price Bid should be quoted in Bid Schedule B Financial Price Bid in the website itself
The bid of the bidders whose GST status is inactive at the time of evaluation will be rejected.
The quantity of materials and work mentioned or indicated in bid may vary depending on the requirement at the time of placing of the work order.
No enhancement of rates once accepted will be considered during the currency of contract, except as provided.
In the matter of dispute regarding the conformity of supplies with the approved quality and or the performance of the contract, the decision of the Corporation is final.

The Corporation reserves the right to accept any or reject any or all the bids without assigning any reason thereof. Incomplete Bids and or bids not accompanied by Bid Guarantee (EMD) will not be accepted
Conditional bids will not be accepted. The bid is of two cover system

technicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should have satisfactorily completed one similar work of Supply, Erection, Testing & Commissioning of HT AB cable work with minimum work order value of Rs.2,02,992/- in any one year during the last five years ( 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24,2024-25 and 2025-26). In proof of experience, Work done certificate with corresponding work order copy for at least one single work issued by an officer rank of Chief Engineer or equivalent/ Head of the Project shall be furnished (Work done of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to present price level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Work done certificate with corresponding work order copies

technicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should be Class-I or above Electrical contractor/Agency/Manufacturer. As a proof of this, a copy of valid electrical license issued by Govt. of Karnataka shall be furnished.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Valid Class-I or above electrical license

technicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer in his name should have in the last five financial years(2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26) achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs.4,05,984/-.As a proof, the tenderer shall furnish profit & loss account and Balance sheet duly certified by Chartered accountant.(financial turnover of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to present price level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited)
